positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "50 Republicans just killed debate on @VAHouseDems efforts to protect women's reproductive choices and enshrine Roe v. Wade in the Virginia Constitution. We will continue to fight for this."

"In the year after the overturning of Roe, we see the role state legislatures play in who continues to have access to reproductive care. Make no mistake, access to reproductive rights are on the line in VA."

"Since the fall of Roe v. Wade, Republicans across the nation have launched constant attacks on reproductive rights in an effort to ban abortion. Today, I’m proud to join lawmakers across the nation in signing a letter opposing the recent attack on access to mifepristone."
Rated 100% by NARAL Pro-Choice Virginia

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "As a father, I’m committed to ensuring that parents have access to paid family leave. This past session, I introduced HB 2035 with @BrianaSewellVA to launch a #paidfamilyleave program in the Commonwealth and will continue to fight for it in the Senate."

"I have friends and neighbors who have had to drop out of the workforce due to lack of paid leave and access to quality childcare when they become parents. This isn't right and it benefits no one. Offering good benefits leads to loyal employees and makes businesses more competitive. Passing family friendly policies would uplift us all."

"I’m proud to have been endorsed by @teamfreedomva! As a Dad, I am dedicated to fighting for policies Freedom Virginia champions like paid family leave, sick leave, affordable childcare, and much more."

"Thank you @FamilyEconomyVA for the #FamilyFriendlyVA Seal of Approval. I’ve dedicated my time in the General Assembly to fighting for #PaidLeave and a #CareEconomyVA that works for families like mine and yours."
